description: senad1_jupyter_notebooks: Project SenAD - Machine learning-based degradation monitoring for asphalt road pavements is a data set deposited in subgoe.gro by its authors Jürgen Dunkel (Hochschule Hannover). A jupyter notebook to learn the road degradation state from the data set of the preliminary SenAD1 project. It is assumed that the data is located in a ‘data’ directory in the project directory. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: JSON, TXT. Size stated: 375012. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
